purpose: One-time confirmatory test of hypotheses formed on executed development evidence: V18 acquisition-v3-coverage versus genuine SMAC3 2.4.1 and Optuna 4.6.0 TPE on the same real C++ sorting and Top-K workers.

policy_definitions.acquisition-v3-coverage: unchanged V18 native CLI, one invocation, 12 matched pairs, base seed S
policy_definitions.smac3_hpo: SMAC3 2.4.1 HyperparameterOptimizationFacade ask/tell, Scenario(deterministic=False, n_trials=12, seed=S), one continuous edge_coordinate in [0, edge_count] floor-clamped to a legal adjacent edge, loss 1/(1+|effect|), censored loss 1, query n config seed S+100000+1000n
policy_definitions.optuna_tpe: Optuna 4.6.0 TPESampler(seed=S, n_startup_trials=4, n_ei_candidates=24), maximize |effect|, censored reward 0, suggest_int edge_index, query n config seed S+100000+1000n

seed_derivation: discovery base S; external query n uses S+100000+1000n (n<12); confirmation of nominated edge j uses 1000000000+10S+j; all derived seeds must be disjoint from every seed list in the repository and from all derived seeds of prior external studies
endpoint: For seed cluster S and policy P: R_P(S) = number of P's nominated edges, summed over both scenarios, whose fresh-seed 20-pair exact sign test is REJECTED_UNDER_UNVERIFIED_SIGN_INDEPENDENCE after within-campaign Holm at alpha 0.05 (0..4).

hypotheses.test: one-sided exact binomial sign test over seed clusters with nonzero difference; p=1 if none
one-sided exact binomial sign test over seed clusters with nonzero difference; p=1 if none

decision_rules.supported: Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05: V18 nominates more fresh-seed-reproducible matched contrasts than that competitor on this endpoint, these two real workloads, this host class and fixed 12-query budget.
decision_rules.not_supported: Otherwise: no advantage over that competitor is established; external competitiveness on this endpoint remains unproven.
decision_rules.incomplete: Any missing, failed or unverifiable trial makes the whole confirmation INCOMPLETE_NO_CLAIM. The cohort is never rerun or extended.

secondary_descriptive_only: discovery wall and CPU per policy (process startup and optimizer overhead are not matched)
truth_status: Real algorithm boundaries are not independently ground-truth labelled. The endpoint measures fresh-seed reproducibility of nominated matched contrasts, not recovery of known boundaries.
